dominant_strengths: Clean SF Pro typography hierarchy with appropriate sizing and weight variations for settings context
Native macOS toggle switches and controls follow platform conventions perfectly
Minimal interface reduces cognitive load with clear information architecture
dominant_weaknesses: Dark theme lacks contrast between panel background and main surface, creating visual flatness
No visual hierarchy beyond typography - missing dividers, spacing, or grouping elements
Generic execution offers no memorable brand identity or innovative interaction patterns
fix_priorities: Add subtle background contrast or border to settings panel for spatial depth
Introduce visual grouping through spacing or subtle dividers between setting categories
Create branded moments through custom icons or micro-interactions on toggles
Implement hover states and transitions to enhance perceived craft quality
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral design with clear controls and predictable patterns, but weak visceral appeal due to flat visual treatment and minimal emotional engagement.
rationale.intent_fit: Successfully delivers functional settings interface but lacks the polish and distinctiveness expected from modern preference panels.
